description: This file defines a custom jQuery UI widget 'nestedSortable' for creating nested sortable lists with advanced features like expand on hover, max levels, and tree structure handling.

classes.name: mjs.nestedSortable
classes.description: A custom jQuery UI widget extending sortable to support nested, tree-like sortable lists with additional options and behaviors.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the nestedSortable widget, sets up classes based on list items, and configures tree options.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up data and restores default sortable behavior.

methods.name: _mouseDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging logic, including level calculations, container interactions, and visual updates during drag.

methods.name: _mouseStop
methods.description: Finalizes the drag operation, repositions the placeholder, and triggers relevant events.

methods.name: _intersectsWithSides
methods.description: Determines if the dragged item intersects with container sides for nesting logic.

methods.name: _contactContainers
methods.description: Checks for interactions with other sortable containers.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Clears empty containers and updates item classes.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the nested list into a structured format.

methods.name: toHierarchy
methods.description: Converts the list into a hierarchical object structure.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the list items with metadata.

methods.name: _clearEmpty
methods.description: Removes empty list containers and updates classes.

methods.name: _getLevel
methods.description: Calculates the nesting level of an item.

methods.name: _isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if nesting/movement is allowed based on options like max levels and root protection.
